role: Build persistent shallow-water reef structure and flow-sorted benthic habitat
silhouette: A shared reef-building family whose flow-sorted colonies range from low encrusting mats through branching and plating crowns to massive domes, with each form readable at gameplay distance.

continuous.name: health
continuous.driver: heat stress moderated by depth and flow

continuous.name: livingColor
continuous.driver: symbiont condition and bounded pigment morph

discrete.name: growthForm
discrete.driver: light, current exposure, sediment load, and succession phase

source.tool: Seeded TypeScript geometry bundled and serialized by Vite/Node
source.procedure: Run npm run asset:coral:generate from the repository root to rebuild deterministic near/far geometry caches.
